app.name: Rust Server Manager
app.tagline: Control your Rust servers from one place

auth.forgotHint: Password recovery is disabled in this demo build. Contact your administrator.
auth.createAccountSubtitle: It takes less than a minute.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.noServers: No servers yet. Click "New Server" to add your first one.

servers.title: Servers
servers.subtitle: Manage all your Rust server instances.

serverPage.notFoundSubtitle: The requested server does not exist.
serverPage.updateConfirmMessage: This will run SteamCMD (app 258550) to update "{{name}}" in {{path}}. The process may take several minutes; the server should be stopped.
serverPage.simMode: Simulation mode — RustDedicatedServer.exe / RustDedicated.exe was not found in the install folder. Set the path in the General tab to launch a real server.
serverPage.simModeDetail: Server executable ({{exes}}) was not found in "{{path}}". Choose the folder containing RustDedicatedServer.exe or RustDedicated.exe in the General tab and save.
serverPage.externalDetected: Process detected in the OS (PID {{pid}}) — started outside the manager.

confirm.stopMessage: The server "{{name}}" will be stopped. All connected players will be disconnected.
confirm.restartMessage: The server "{{name}}" will be restarted. This takes about 30 seconds.
confirm.deleteServerMessage: The server "{{name}}" will be removed from the manager. Files on disk will not be touched.

general.gamemodeHint: Game modes: vanilla, softcore, hardcore, primitive. Devs recommend leaving it empty (plain Vanilla) instead of "vanilla".
general.nameHint: Server name shown in the server list. Limit 64 chars (32 for Cyrillic). Don't mention pirates, skins or free DLC.
general.urlHint: URL shown in the server description window.
general.logoImageHint: Server logo for Rust+ and the description window (PNG/JPG, 256×256).
general.descriptionHint: Server description. Use \n for a new line.
general.tagsHint: Available tags: pve, roleplay, creative, minigame, training, battlefield, broyale, builds. Up to 3 tags.
general.wipeTagHint: Wipe frequency tag shown in the server list: weekly, biweekly, monthly.
general.regionTagHint: Region tag for the server list: eu, na, ru, sa, as, oc, af.
general.autoUpdateHint: Update the server and Oxide on every start/restart via the manager.
general.eacHint: Anti-cheat (server.secure). EAC is required on modern builds.
general.installPathHint: Folder with RustDedicatedServer.exe / RustDedicated.exe. Pick any folder and press the server's "Update Server" button to install it via SteamCMD (empty = simulation)
general.installPathInvalid: No server executable (RustDedicatedServer.exe / RustDedicated.exe) found in this folder. Choose the folder that contains it.
general.rconInsecureWarning: Weak password: Rust disables RCON for known simple passwords (e.g. "changeme") and passwords shorter than 8 characters. Use a unique password.
general.autoRestartCrashHint: If the process ends unexpectedly, the manager restarts the server automatically (up to 3 times per 30 minutes).
general.autoRestartHangHint: If the server produces no output for the configured time, it is considered hung — the process is killed and restarted.
general.hangTimeoutHint: How many minutes of silence before the server is treated as hung. For fresh worlds with long generation, use 15+ minutes.
general.startWithManagerHint: Launch this server automatically when the manager starts.

errors.seedInvalid: Seed must be a positive integer.
errors.worldSizeInvalid: World size must be between 1000 and 6000.
errors.maxPlayersInvalid: Max players must be between 1 and 500.
errors.rconPasswordChars: Allowed: letters (A-Z, a-z), digits (0-9), underscores (_), dots (.) and dashes (-).
errors.saveIntervalInvalid: Save interval must be between 30 and 3600 seconds.
errors.queryportInvalid: Query port must be between 1024 and 65535.
errors.rconPortInvalid: RCON port must be between 1 and 65535.

console.title: RCON Console
console.browserDemo: Browser demo: real WebRcon requires the Electron app. Commands are simulated.
console.bridgeError: WebRcon bridge is not available in browser demo mode.
console.errorRefused: The server hasn't opened the WebRcon port: it may still be generating the world, or the process is not running.
console.errorNonWebsocket: The port does not speak WebRcon. Make sure you entered the RCON port (usually game port + 2) and that rcon.web is enabled.
console.errorAuth: Wrong RCON password. The server uses the password saved at the moment it was started: if you changed rcon.password in General after starting — restart the server.
console.errorTimeout: RCON timed out — the server may still be starting up.
console.errorInsecurePasswordHint: Tip: a weak password disables RCON — Rust rejects "changeme", "password" and short passwords. Set a unique password (8+ chars) in General.
console.processLogHint: Lines tagged [Server] come from the server's log file Logs/server-<identity>.log: past lines load on open, new ones appear automatically, no RCON required.
console.connectHint: RCON becomes available only after the world is fully generated (may take 5–15 minutes).
console.serverNotRunning: Server is not running — past log lines are hidden.
console.notConnectedHonest: RCON is not connected — command was not sent. Connect above (RCON opens after the world finishes generating).
console.serverStoppedCmd: Server is not running — command was not sent.

plugins.updateAllMessage: {{count}} plugin(s) have newer versions on uMod. They will be downloaded and replace the local files.
plugins.deleteMessage: The plugin "{{name}}" ({{file}}) will be permanently removed from the plugins folder. This action cannot be undone.
plugins.notFoundHint: Set the install path in the General tab, then rescan.
plugins.noPlugins: No plugins found in the scan folders.
plugins.browserDemo: Browser demo: real plugin scanning requires the Electron app. Sample list shown.

wipes.demoMode: Browser demo mode — wipes are simulated.
wipes.simulated: Install path not set — wipes are simulated.
wipes.dateRequired: Choose the date and time of the next wipe.
wipes.wipeNowMessage: This will immediately wipe "{{name}}" — deletes .map/.db files{{suffix}} and regenerates the seed. This cannot be undone.
wipes.removeMessage: The scheduled wipe ({{frequency}}) will be removed from the queue for "{{name}}".

discord.title: Discord Webhook
discord.description: Notifications are sent to a Discord channel via an incoming webhook. Create one in Discord → Server Settings → Integrations → Webhooks, then paste the URL below.
discord.bridgeRequired: Electron app required for this action.
discord.browserDemo: Browser demo: real webhook delivery requires the Electron app.

account.title: Account
account.subtitle: Your profile and license details.
account.sessionHint: Signing out returns you to the authorization screen.
account.autoLaunchHint: Start the manager automatically when you sign in to Windows (open to tray).

discord.startDesc: Server **"{{name}}"** started successfully and is now available to players!
discord.stopDesc: Server **"{{name}}"** has been stopped by an administrator.
discord.crashDesc: Attention! The process of server **"{{name}}"** has crashed. Starting Crash Recovery...
discord.wipeDesc: The wipe on server **"{{name}}"** has been completed!
discord.testDesc: Rust Server Manager integration has been configured successfully!

marketplace.author: Author
marketplace.networkError: uMod is unreachable. Check your internet connection.
marketplace.installPathNeeded: Set the server install path in the General tab.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.subtitle: Automatic daily restarts with in-game warnings and scheduled world backups.
schedule.browserDemo: Browser demo: scheduling requires the Electron app.

players.title: Players
players.notConnected: Connect to RCON to manage players (button above or the Console tab).
players.name: Name
players.kickMessage: Player "{{name}}" will be disconnected from the server.
players.banMessage: Player "{{name}}" will be banned and won't be able to join.
players.unbanMessage: The ban for "{{name}}" will be lifted.
players.browserDemo: Browser demo: player management requires RCON (Electron app).
players.tempBansEmpty: No temporary bans. Set a duration in the ban dialog to auto-unban.

backups.title: World backups
backups.empty: No backups yet. Create a backup before a wipe or update.
backups.restoreMessage: Files from backup "{{id}}" will be copied into the world folder. Stop the server before restoring.

analytics.title: Attendance
analytics.noData: No data yet. The server will start collecting samples after launch.

logs.title: Server log
logs.browserDemo: Browser demo: log browsing requires the Electron app.
logs.empty: Log file not found. Start the server to create it.

telegram.title: Telegram notifications
telegram.description: Events are sent to your Telegram chat via a bot. Create a bot with @BotFather and get its token, then enter the chat id.
telegram.fieldsRequired: Enter bot token and chat id.
telegram.browserDemo: Browser demo: Telegram requires the Electron app.
telegram.bridgeRequired: Telegram bridge is not available in browser demo mode.

ports.title: Server Ports
ports.hint: Local port status and Windows Firewall rules. Opening a port requires administrator rights — a UAC prompt will appear. If the server is behind a router, forward the ports there as well.
ports.browserDemo: Browser demo: port checking requires the Electron app.

mods.title: Mod Manager
mods.hint: Install or update the Oxide (uMod) modding framework for the server. The archive is downloaded from the official source and extracted into the server folder. Stop the server before installing.
mods.installPathNeeded: Set the server install path in the General tab to install mods.
mods.browserDemo: Browser demo: mod installation requires the Electron app.
mods.installed: {{mod}} installed (v{{version}}). Restart the server to activate.
mods.removeMessage: The framework folder (oxide/) and its files in RustDedicated_Data/Managed will be deleted. Stop the server first.
